description: Orient on this Ship — ALWAYS call this first. With no arguments it returns the section MAP and nothing else: every top-level section with its description and child_count, which is small and cheap even on a Ship of hundreds of nodes. Then pass { section_id } to list one section's direct children, and vpshardening__read_node for the ones worth reading. A large section arrives in pages — continue it with { cursor }.
name: vpshardening__get_ship_digest
